capabilities: Display daily notes as weekly cards with excerpts, tasks, focus time and word counts
Read and edit recent days in a continuous stream, ticking tasks in place
Create missing daily notes from the daily notes template
Summarize streaks, weekly focus time, word counts and open tasks with filters
Match board colours to themes, including the Static Aurora theme
disambiguation: Not a kanban or task board; the cards are your daily notes, and tasks are only read and ticked inside them.
extras: States it makes no network requests and only writes to daily notes when you tick tasks, edit or create a day. Backgrounds can be vault images, built-in aurora pictures, or live colours matched to the Static Aurora theme.
intentEvidence: uses the core Daily Notes plugin's folder, date format and template by default
problem: Obsidian's Daily Notes core plugin only opens or lists single daily notes, with no at-a-glance weekly overview of what was written, what tasks remain and how much was focused.
